# hetero_budget reference fixture — InternalConsistency, NOT Validated

`reference.json` is generated by `scripts/gen_hetero_budget_reference.py`, an
independent numpy + stdlib-`statistics` computation of the R2 heterogeneous-budget algebra
(integrity-bias overbound, correlated cross-covariance, correlated-vs-independent
fused bias) on a fixed synthetic source set.

This is an **internal-consistency** check that the Rust and numpy implementations
of the *same algebra* agree — it is **NOT** an external accuracy oracle and does
**NOT** earn a `Validated` tag. P2 makes no new accuracy claim of its own; the
per-source bias overbounds are Proven constructions over Cited metrology inputs.
The deep integrity tail is Modelled.
